entries.why: Explained. Cell I_DEPO <- K_GSTA: 2,45,444 -> 2,53,168 (7,724, +3.1%; 2 entries). Largest moves: capital_financial K7 dom_pos 7,601 (+3.0%); capital_financial K7 dom_neg 123 (+3.0%). The largest mover is explained under its entry: The GG and FC capital accounts close through their saving priors, which balancing moved (K3a: the Centre down, the States up, toward FSF; K2a: banks down, NBFCs up). The GFCF, G-sec and loan totals are held (cf.i1a.gfcf.gg, production's gfcf.c_cnst, the cf.k8.* issuance totals), so only this block's keys can move: the Centre/State GFCF key (capital_financial-11, which leaves out ULB capital expenditure 1,07,404 and CSS spending outside State treasuries, both of which point the same way) and the issuer-vs-holder G-sec and deposit splits (capital_financial-29). The moves are a few per cent.
